name: 王秋玄
objective: This course introduces fundamental concepts and practices of interaction design through creative coding and hands-on experimentation. Students will explore the relationships among user input, system behavior, visual representation, sound, and feedback, and learn how these elements contribute to interactive experiences. Through practical exercises with p5.js and live coding tools, the course covers generative graphics, user interaction, computational patterns, sound and rhythm, and audiovisual interaction. Emphasis is placed on learning through making, experimentation, and iterative design. Students will apply the concepts and techniques learned throughout the course to develop creative interactive projects that integrate computational thinking with visual and auditory expression.
